clue: I am tiny, but I can carry a crumb much bigger than me all the way home. Drop jam at a picnic and I come in a line.
nudge: A tiny bug that marches in long lines and lives in a hill of dirt.

clue: I swing from tree to tree on long arms. I look a lot like a monkey, but I have no tail.
nudge: A big hairy animal like a gorilla or a chimp. Three letters.

clue: All day I sleep upside down in a dark cave. At night I fly out to catch bugs.
nudge: A flying animal with furry wings. Same name as the thing you hit a ball with.

clue: I love honey and fish from the river. When it gets cold, I sleep in my den all winter long.
nudge: A big furry animal. Teddy is a toy one.

clue: I buzz from flower to flower all day. If you bother me, I might sting you!
nudge: A striped buzzing bug that makes honey.

clue: I came out of an egg. I have feathers and wings, and I sing in the tree outside your window.
nudge: Sparrows, parrots and crows are all this kind of animal.

clue: I look like a farm pig, but I live wild in the forest. I have hairy skin and two sharp tusks.
nudge: A wild pig. It sounds like the word for not fun at all.

clue: I have two big horns and I snort. People say I get angry when someone waves a red cape at me.
nudge: The daddy of a calf on the farm.

clue: I was born on the farm last week. My legs are wobbly and I drink milk from my mother cow.
nudge: A baby cow. It is also the back part of your leg.

clue: I walk across hot sand for days with no water. I carry people on my back, over my big hump.
nudge: A desert animal with one or two humps.

clue: I purr when you pet me, I chase mice, and I always land on my feet.
nudge: A furry pet that says meow.

clue: I have spots like a leopard. No animal on land can run faster than me. I can zoom as fast as a car!
nudge: The fastest runner of all the big cats.

clue: I just pecked my way out of my egg. I am small, yellow and fluffy, and I say peep peep.
nudge: A baby hen.

clue: I am a smart ape. I poke a stick into a bug hill and pull it out covered in snacks.
nudge: A clever ape, a cousin of the gorilla. Rhymes with limp.

clue: I hide in the wet sand at the beach. My soft body lives between two shells that snap shut.
nudge: A shellfish. Rhymes with jam.

clue: I have no legs. When I am angry, I lift my head, spread my neck wide and hiss.
nudge: A snake that a snake charmer plays music for.

clue: I am a young boy horse. My legs are long and I love to gallop around the field.
nudge: A baby boy horse. Rhymes with bolt.

clue: I walk sideways on the beach. If you poke me, I pinch you with my two claws!
nudge: A sea animal with a hard shell and pinchers.

clue: I stand on one thin leg in the pond. My neck is long. A big machine that lifts things has my name.
nudge: A tall bird. Also a tall machine at building sites.

clue: I am black all over and I say caw caw. Farmers put a straw man in the field to keep me away.
nudge: A big black bird. Rhymes with snow.

clue: My mom is a lion, a bear or a tiger. I am small and I love to wrestle with my brothers.
nudge: A baby bear or lion. Rhymes with tub.

clue: I am shy and I live in the forest. The daddies have big branches growing on their heads.
nudge: Bambi is one. It sounds like the start of a letter: Dear.

clue: I wag my tail when you come home. I love to play fetch at the park and I bark at the mailman.
nudge: A pet that says woof.

clue: I live in the sea, but I breathe air through a hole on my head. I jump over waves and click to my friends.
nudge: A smart, friendly sea animal that loves to jump and play.

clue: I am a soft white bird. I coo gently, and people draw me with a leaf in my beak to mean peace.
nudge: A white bird of peace. Rhymes with love.

clue: I paddle on the pond with my flat orange feet. Throw me some bread and I will say quack!
nudge: A pond bird that quacks.

clue: I fly very high over the mountains. My eyes are so sharp I can see a rabbit from far up in the sky.
nudge: A big strong bird with a hooked beak. America's bird.

clue: I look like a snake, but I live in water and I am a fish. Try to hold me and I slip right out!
nudge: A long slippery fish. Rhymes with meal.

clue: I am a big deer with huge antlers. In the fall, I make a loud whistle call in the woods.
nudge: A large deer. Only three letters.

clue: I am a tall bird from Australia. I cannot fly, but I can run very fast on my long legs.
nudge: A big bird from Australia, like an ostrich. Three letters.

clue: I dive down from the sky faster than any other animal. I grab my lunch with my sharp feet.
nudge: A fast hunting bird, a bit like a hawk.

clue: I am a baby deer. I have white spots on my back so I can hide in the grass.
nudge: A baby deer. Rhymes with lawn.

clue: I am a long, skinny pet. I love to squeeze into tubes and steal your socks to hide them.
nudge: A long furry pet that looks a bit like a weasel.

clue: I am a tiny bird that sings. I love seeds, and you can see me at a bird feeder.
nudge: A small song bird. Rhymes with pinch.

clue: I live in water and breathe with gills. I have fins and a tail. Some kids keep me in a bowl.
nudge: Salmon, tuna and sharks are all this.

clue: I am a pink bird. I stand on one leg in the water, and the food I eat is what makes me pink.
nudge: A pink bird with long legs.

clue: I am a tiny bug that jumps really high. I hide in a dog's fur and make it scratch and scratch.
nudge: A tiny jumping bug that bites pets.

clue: I buzz around your dinner and land on your food. You wave your hand, but I come right back.
nudge: A buzzing bug. It is also what birds do with wings.

clue: I have red fur and a big bushy tail. In stories, I am the sly, tricky one.
nudge: A clever animal that looks like a small red dog.

clue: I start life with a tail in the pond. Now I hop, I say ribbit, and I catch bugs with my sticky tongue.
nudge: A green hopper that croaks.

clue: I live in Africa. I am fast and light, and I leap high to get away from lions.
nudge: A fast, small antelope with thin horns.

clue: I am a small lizard. My sticky toes let me walk up walls and even across the ceiling.
nudge: A little lizard that can climb glass.

clue: I am a small pet with a long tail. I dig in my cage and run on my wheel.
nudge: A little pet like a hamster, but with a long tail.

clue: I am the tallest animal at the zoo. I eat leaves from the top of the tree without even jumping.
nudge: An animal with a very long neck and spots.

clue: I climb rocks, I have a little beard, and I will try to eat almost anything, even your shirt!
nudge: A farm animal that says maa. Its kids are babies.

clue: I am a big white bird at the farm pond. I honk loudly and chase people who come too close.
nudge: A big bird like a duck. More than one is geese.

clue: I am the biggest ape. When I want to look tough, I stand up and beat my chest.
nudge: A huge, strong ape from the jungle.

clue: I fly over the beach and cry loudly. Leave your chips open and I will swoop down and grab them!
nudge: A white beach bird. Often called a sea one.

clue: I am a small pet. I stuff food in my cheeks till they puff up, then run on my wheel all night.
nudge: A small furry pet with chubby cheeks.

clue: I look like a big rabbit with long ears. In a famous story, I lost a race to a slow tortoise.
nudge: A fast animal like a rabbit. It sounds like hair.

clue: I circle high above the field. When I see a mouse, I dive down and grab it with my claws.
nudge: A hunting bird with sharp eyes. Rhymes with walk.

clue: I am small and covered in prickles. When I am scared, I roll up into a spiky ball.
nudge: A small spiky animal. Sonic is a blue one.

clue: I live on the farm, I cluck, and every morning I lay an egg for your breakfast.
nudge: A mother chicken. Rhymes with ten.

clue: I stand still in shallow water on my long legs. Then, quick as a flash, my long beak grabs a fish.
nudge: A tall gray bird that fishes in ponds.

clue: I am huge and I spend my day in the river. When I open my mouth wide, you can see my giant teeth.
nudge: A huge, round river animal from Africa. Rhymes with zippo.

clue: I am like a big, angry wasp. Knock my paper nest and I will chase you and sting!
nudge: A large stinging insect.

clue: I have a mane and hooves. You can ride on my back, and I say neigh.
nudge: An animal people ride. A pony is a small one.

clue: I am a dog with a great nose. Hunters follow me as I sniff out a trail.
nudge: A hunting dog. Rhymes with sound.

clue: I live in Africa and eat what lions leave behind. The noise I make sounds just like laughing.
nudge: An animal that sounds like it is giggling.

clue: I am a big green lizard with spikes down my back. Some people keep me as a pet.
nudge: A big lizard that likes to sit in the sun.

clue: I am a deer like animal in Africa. I can jump higher than a car to get away from a lion.
nudge: An African antelope. Also the name of a car.

clue: I have six legs and a body in three parts. Ants, bees and beetles are all me.
nudge: The group name for bugs with six legs.

clue: I look like a thin wild dog. I howl at night in hot, dry lands and eat leftovers.
nudge: A wild dog from Africa and Asia.

clue: I am a big spotted cat from the rainforest. Unlike most cats, I love to swim.
nudge: A big spotted cat. Also the name of a fancy car.

clue: I am a noisy blue bird. I hide nuts in the ground and squawk at cats.
nudge: A bird whose name is also the letter J.

clue: I float in the sea like a see through bag. I have no bones, and my long strings can sting you.
nudge: A wobbly sea animal. Its name has a dessert in it.

clue: I am a baby who rides in my mom's pocket. When I peek out, I see her hopping across Australia.
nudge: A baby kangaroo.

clue: I hop around Australia on big back feet. I carry my baby in a pouch on my tummy.
nudge: The biggest hopping animal. Its baby is a joey.

clue: I am small and fluffy. I chase balls of yarn and mew for my mother cat.
nudge: A baby cat.

clue: I am a brown bird from New Zealand. I cannot fly, and a fuzzy green fruit has my name.
nudge: A bird that shares its name with a fuzzy fruit.

clue: I hug a tree all day in Australia. I eat leaves and sleep most of the time. I look like a teddy.
nudge: A cuddly gray tree animal from Australia.

clue: I am a tiny round beetle. My back is red with black dots, and I might land on your finger.
nudge: A tiny red beetle with black spots.

clue: I am a baby sheep. Mary had a little one in the song, and my fleece was white as snow.
nudge: A baby sheep. The b at the end is silent.

clue: I am a big cat with spots. I drag my food up a tree so lions cannot steal it.
nudge: A spotted big cat that climbs trees.

clue: I have a big furry mane and a loud roar. People call me the king of the jungle.
nudge: Simba is one. So is Aslan in Narnia.

clue: I have scaly skin and four legs. I lie on a warm rock in the sun, and my tail can drop off.
nudge: A small scaly animal like a gecko.

clue: I live in the mountains of South America. I have a long neck and soft wool, and if I am cross, I spit!
nudge: A woolly animal that spits. Starts with two of the same letter.

clue: I walk on the sea floor with two big claws. I am blue or brown, but I turn red when cooked.
nudge: A big sea animal with claws, like a big crab.

clue: I am a wild cat with a short tail. I have little pointy bits of fur on the tips of my ears.
nudge: A wild cat with tufted ears. No vowels except y.

clue: I am a big, bright parrot. My feathers are red, blue and yellow, and I squawk loudly.
nudge: A large colorful parrot.

clue: I am a black and white bird. I love shiny things and might steal your ring!
nudge: A black and white bird that likes shiny things.

clue: I lived long ago in the Ice Age. I looked like a hairy elephant with long curly tusks.
nudge: A furry elephant from long ago.

clue: I am a big, slow, gentle sea animal. I munch on sea grass, so people call me a sea cow.
nudge: A gentle sea cow that swims slowly.

clue: I am a green insect. I hold my front legs together, like I am saying a prayer, while I wait for bugs.
nudge: An insect called the praying one.

clue: I live in the desert in a big family. I stand up on my back legs to look out for danger.
nudge: A small desert animal that stands up tall to watch.

clue: I am a small animal with soft, shiny brown fur. I swim well and catch fish.
nudge: A small swimmer with soft fur. Rhymes with pink.

clue: I live under the ground and dig tunnels with my big front paws. My eyes are tiny and I can hardly see.
nudge: A digging animal. It is also a small dark spot on skin.

clue: I swing in the trees by my long tail. I chatter, I play, and I love bananas.
nudge: A playful animal that climbs and loves bananas.

clue: I am the biggest deer of all. My antlers are flat and wide, and I live where it snows.
nudge: A giant deer. Rhymes with goose.

clue: I look like a butterfly, but I fly at night. I flutter around the porch light.
nudge: A night bug drawn to lamps.

clue: I am tiny and squeak. I love cheese, and I run away fast when I see a cat.
nudge: A small squeaky animal. Also part of a computer.

clue: My mom is a horse and my dad is a donkey. I carry heavy bags, and people say I am stubborn.
nudge: Half horse, half donkey. Rhymes with rule.

clue: I am a small animal with wet skin and a tail. I live near ponds and look like a tiny lizard.
nudge: A small pond animal with a tail. Rhymes with cute.

clue: I live in the sea and have eight arms. When I am scared, I squirt ink and swim away.
nudge: A sea animal with eight arms.

clue: I am a black and white whale. I hunt in a family group and I am very smart.
nudge: A killer whale.

clue: I am the biggest bird in the world. I cannot fly, but I run fast, and my egg is huge.
nudge: A giant bird with long legs that cannot fly.

clue: I float on my back in the water and crack shells on my tummy. I hold hands with friends when I sleep.
nudge: A playful furry swimmer. Rhymes with water.

clue: I stay awake all night and say hoo hoo. I can turn my head almost all the way around.
nudge: A night bird with big round eyes.

clue: I am a big, strong farm animal. I pull heavy carts and plows across the field.
nudge: A strong farm animal. Just two letters.

clue: I live in the sea in a rough shell. Sometimes a pearl grows inside me.
nudge: A shellfish that can make a pearl.

clue: I am a black and white bear from China. I munch on bamboo all day long.
nudge: A black and white bear that eats bamboo.

clue: I am a big cat with shiny black fur. At night, I am very hard to see.
nudge: A big black cat. Bagheera in The Jungle Book.

clue: I have bright green feathers. If you say hello to me again and again, I might say it back!
nudge: A colorful bird that can copy words.

clue: I am a bird who shows off. I open my tail like a huge fan full of blue and green eyes.
nudge: A bird with a beautiful fan tail.

clue: I am a big sea bird. I scoop up fish in a big stretchy pouch under my beak.
nudge: A bird with a pouch under its beak.

clue: I am a black and white bird who cannot fly. I waddle on the ice and swim fast in cold seas.
nudge: A bird that looks like it wears a suit.

clue: I am pink and I love to roll in mud. I say oink oink on the farm.
nudge: A farm animal with a curly tail.

clue: I am a gray bird in the city. I walk around the park looking for bread crumbs.
nudge: A city bird that coos.

clue: I have a bill like a duck, fur like an otter and I lay eggs. I live in Australia.
nudge: A strange animal from Australia with a duck bill.

clue: I look like a small horse. Kids can ride me at a fair or a birthday party.
nudge: A small kind of horse.

clue: My back is covered with sharp spines. If a dog bothers me, he gets a nose full of them!
nudge: A spiky animal, bigger than a hedgehog.

clue: I am a little sea bird with a bright, colorful beak. I can hold many small fish in it at once.
nudge: A small sea bird with a big orange beak.

clue: I am a big wild cat with plain tan fur. I live in the mountains and I can jump very far.
nudge: A big tan cat. Also a shoe brand.

clue: I am a baby dog. I chew your shoes, chase my tail, and lick your face.
nudge: A baby dog.

clue: I am a big snake with no poison. I wrap my body around my food and squeeze.
nudge: A huge snake that squeezes.

clue: I am a small, round bird that lives on the ground. My tiny eggs have brown spots.
nudge: A small plump bird. Starts with Q.

clue: I have long ears and a fluffy tail. I hop around and love to nibble carrots.
nudge: A hopping pet. Bugs Bunny is one.

clue: I have a black mask around my eyes and a striped tail. At night, I dig through your trash.
nudge: A masked animal that raids trash cans.

clue: I am a daddy sheep with big curly horns. I bang my head into other sheep to show who is boss.
nudge: A male sheep. Rhymes with jam.

clue: I look like a mouse, but bigger, with a long bare tail. I live in sewers and city alleys.
nudge: A big cousin of the mouse. Rhymes with cat.

clue: I am a big black bird, even bigger than a crow. I am very smart and I croak instead of sing.
nudge: A large black bird, like a big crow.

clue: I live where it is snowy and cold. In stories, I pull a sleigh full of toys on Christmas Eve.
nudge: Rudolph is one, with a red nose.

clue: I am huge with thick gray skin. I have one or two big horns right on my nose.
nudge: A big animal with a horn on its nose.

clue: I am a small bird with an orange red chest. I pull worms out of the lawn in spring.
nudge: A bird with a red chest. Also Batman's helper.

clue: I am the daddy chicken. I wake up the whole farm in the morning with cock a doodle doo!
nudge: A male chicken that crows at sunrise.

clue: I am a pink fish. I swim up the river and jump up waterfalls to get home. Bears try to catch me.
nudge: A pink fish that bears love to catch.

clue: I am a smooth swimmer with flippers. I lie on the rocks, bark, and clap at the zoo.
nudge: An ocean animal that barks. Also a stamp on a letter.

clue: I swim in the sea with a fin sticking out of the water. When I lose a tooth, a new one grows in.
nudge: A big sea fish with lots of teeth. Jaws is one.

clue: I am fluffy and white on the farm. I say baa, and my wool is cut off to make your sweater.
nudge: A woolly farm animal. You count them to fall asleep.

clue: I am a tiny sea animal that curls up. I turn pink when cooked, and people dip me in sauce.
nudge: A small curly sea food. A short person is jokingly called one.

clue: I am black with a white stripe. If you scare me, I lift my tail and spray a really bad smell!
nudge: A stinky black and white animal.

clue: I hang upside down in the jungle trees. I move so slowly that green stuff grows on my fur.
nudge: The slowest animal in the trees.

clue: I carry my house on my back. I am very slow, and I leave a shiny slime trail on the path.
nudge: A slow animal with a shell on its back.

clue: I have no legs, but I slither on the ground. I smell with my forked tongue and say hiss.
nudge: A long animal that hisses. Cobras and pythons are this.

clue: I am a small brown bird. You see me hopping around the park and on your windowsill.
nudge: A common little brown bird.

clue: I have eight legs. I spin a sticky web in the corner and wait for a fly to get stuck.
nudge: An eight legged web maker.

clue: I live in the sea and have ten arms. When I am in danger, I shoot out dark ink and zoom away.
nudge: A sea animal like an octopus, with ten arms.

clue: I have a bushy tail. I run up trees and hide nuts in the ground to eat in winter.
nudge: A furry tree climber that collects acorns.

clue: I live in the sea and have five arms. If I lose one, a new one grows back!
nudge: A sea animal shaped like the things that twinkle at night.

clue: I am a tall white bird with long red legs. In old tales, I fly new babies to their families.
nudge: A tall bird said to bring babies.

clue: I am a little bird with a forked tail. I zoom through the air and catch bugs. It is also what you do with food.
nudge: A small fast bird. You also do it when you eat.

clue: I am a big white bird with a long curvy neck. I glide on the lake. An ugly duckling grew up to be me.
nudge: A graceful white bird on a lake.

clue: I am a baby that swims in the pond with a tail. One day I will grow legs and hop out as a frog.
nudge: A baby frog.

clue: I look like a pig, but my nose is long like a tiny elephant trunk. I live in the jungle.
nudge: A jungle animal with a short, bendy nose.

clue: I am a tiny bug that eats wood. My friends and I can chew through a whole wooden house!
nudge: A small bug that eats wood.

clue: I am a big orange cat with black stripes. I hunt in the jungle and I love water.
nudge: A big striped cat. Tigger is a toy one.

clue: I look like a frog, but my skin is dry and bumpy. I hop around the garden at night.
nudge: A bumpy cousin of the frog. Rhymes with road.

clue: I live in the rainforest. My beak is huge and bright orange, almost as big as my body.
nudge: A bird with a giant colorful beak.

clue: I am a fish with spots who lives in cool rivers. People stand in the stream to try and catch me.
nudge: A spotted river fish. Rhymes with shout.

clue: I am a big farm bird. I say gobble gobble, and many families eat me on Thanksgiving.
nudge: A big bird people eat on Thanksgiving.

clue: I am slow and carry a hard shell. When I am scared, I pull my head inside.
nudge: A slow animal with a shell. Some live in the sea.

clue: I am a snake with long fangs. My bite has poison, so stay away!
nudge: A dangerous biting snake.

clue: I am a big bird with a bald head. I circle high in the sky looking for dead animals to eat.
nudge: A bald bird that circles over the desert.

clue: I live in icy seas. I have whiskers, a big mustache, and two long white tusks.
nudge: A big sea animal with long tusks.

clue: I am a yellow and black bug with a thin waist. I come to your picnic to steal your soda and I sting!
nudge: A stinging bug like a bee, but meaner.

clue: I am a long, thin, sneaky animal. I can squeeze into tiny holes to catch mice.
nudge: A small sneaky animal. Pop goes this in a song.

clue: I am the biggest animal in the ocean. I blow water out of a hole on my head.
nudge: A giant sea animal that spouts water.

clue: I howl at the moon and hunt in a pack. In a fairy tale, I huffed and puffed at three pigs' houses.
nudge: A wild dog that howls. The bad guy in Red Riding Hood.

clue: I am a chubby animal from Australia. I dig burrows, and my poop comes out shaped like cubes!
nudge: A furry digger from Australia.

clue: Tap tap tap! I bang my beak into tree trunks again and again to find bugs inside.
nudge: A bird that drills holes in trees.

clue: I am long and wiggly with no legs. After it rains, I come up out of the dirt. Birds love to eat me.
nudge: A wiggly animal in the garden soil.

clue: I am a very tiny brown bird. My tail sticks straight up, and I sing a loud song.
nudge: A tiny bird. It sounds like when.

clue: I live high in the cold mountains. I am like a big cow with long shaggy hair down to the ground.
nudge: A hairy cow from the mountains. Rhymes with back.

clue: I look like a horse in pajamas! I have black and white stripes and live in Africa.
nudge: A striped horse from Africa.

clue: I am a huge sea bird with the widest wings of all. I can glide over the ocean for days.
nudge: A sea bird with giant wings.

clue: I lie in the swamp like a log, with only my eyes showing. I have a wide snout and lots of teeth.
nudge: A big green reptile in swamps, like a crocodile.

clue: I look like a small fluffy llama. My soft wool makes warm sweaters.
nudge: A woolly animal like a llama, but smaller.

clue: I am a giant snake in the South American jungle. I swim in rivers and squeeze my food.
nudge: One of the biggest snakes in the world.

clue: I look like a deer with long, straight horns. I run very fast across the grassy plains.
nudge: A fast animal like a deer, from Africa.

clue: My body is covered in hard plates like armor. Some of us can roll up into a ball.
nudge: An animal wearing a suit of armor.

clue: I am a big monkey with a dog like face and a bright red bottom. I live in Africa.
nudge: A monkey with a red bottom.

clue: I have a black and white striped face. I dig deep holes in the ground with my strong claws.
nudge: A digging animal with a striped face.

clue: I am long and silver with a mouth full of pointy teeth. I zoom through the sea like an arrow.
nudge: A long, toothy sea fish.

clue: I am a small dog with floppy ears and a great nose. Snoopy from the comics is one of me.
nudge: The kind of dog Snoopy is.

clue: I chew down trees with my big front teeth. I build a dam in the river with sticks and mud.
nudge: An animal that builds dams.

clue: I am a bug with a hard, shiny shell. A ladybug is one of my family.
nudge: An insect with a hard back.

clue: I am big and shaggy with a hump and short horns. Long ago, huge herds of me ran across America.
nudge: An American buffalo.

clue: I am as dark as night and I sing in the garden. In a song, twenty four of me were baked in a pie!
nudge: Its name is a color plus what it is: something with wings.

clue: I am noisy, with a pointy tuft of feathers on my head. I am the color of the sky, and I yell at cats.
nudge: The color of the sky plus a three letter name.

clue: I am a wild hunter with pointy ears and a short tail, like it was cut off. I chase rabbits at night.
nudge: A small wild cousin of your pet kitty, with a stubby tail.

clue: I look like a big cow with huge curved horns. In hot lands, I pull carts and roll in mud.
nudge: A big strong animal with horns. Bison are also called this.

clue: I have a wrinkly face, short legs and a big jaw. I look grumpy, but I am a sweetie who loves naps.
nudge: A wrinkly faced pet that barks.

clue: I was a caterpillar, then I slept in a little case. Now I flutter around on bright, beautiful wings.
nudge: A colorful insect with big wings.

clue: I float in circles high above the desert. I am waiting for something to stop moving so I can eat it.
nudge: A big bird like a vulture. It has two Zs.

clue: I am small and yellow and I sing sweetly. Tweety from the cartoons is one of me.
nudge: A yellow singing pet bird.

clue: I am a big deer that walks in huge herds in the frozen north. The ones that pull Santa's sleigh are my cousins.
nudge: A big deer of the north, like a reindeer.

clue: I am a fuzzy crawler with lots of legs. I munch leaves, then wrap up and wake up with wings.

clue: Write a letter, put on a stamp, and drop it in the postbox.
nudge: Make something go to someone.

clue: Careful! The knife edge can cut you, and the needle point can poke you.
nudge: Not blunt.

clue: The sun comes out and fills the sky with bright light.
nudge: Give off light.

clue: Your friend is far across the field. You yell her name as loud as you can.
nudge: Say something very loudly.

clue: You hold up your drawing so the whole class can see it.
nudge: Let someone see.

clue: The owl flies through the night without a single sound.
nudge: Making no noise at all.

clue: 2 plus 2 is 4. That sum is so easy!
nudge: Easy, not hard.

clue: Happy birthday to you! Everyone uses their voice to make music.
nudge: Make music with your voice.

clue: The artist makes a quick pencil drawing of the cat before she paints it.
nudge: A fast, rough drawing.

clue: Swing the rope over your head and jump over it as it comes around.
nudge: Hop along, or jump a rope.

clue: Close your eyes, snuggle in bed, and dream all night.
nudge: What you do at night in bed.

clue: The snail takes all day to cross the garden path.
nudge: The opposite of fast.

clue: Riya solves the hardest puzzle in the class in two minutes. She is so...
nudge: Clever.

clue: Someone says Cheese! for a photo. The corners of your mouth go up.
nudge: A happy face.

clue: Run your hand over the glass window. No bumps at all!
nudge: Not rough.

clue: The eagle flies higher and higher above the mountains.
nudge: Fly high up.

clue: You think hard and find the answer to the riddle!
nudge: Work out the answer.

clue: Put all the red blocks here, the blue ones there, and the green ones over there.
nudge: Put into groups.

clue: The diamond ring catches the sun and flashes with tiny bits of light.
nudge: Shine with little flashes, like glitter.

clue: Open your mouth and say words so people can hear you.
nudge: Talk.

clue: How fast is the car going? 60 kilometers an hour.
nudge: How fast something goes.

clue: The top turns round and round on one spot until it falls.
nudge: Turn round and round.

clue: Jump into the puddle! Water flies everywhere and your socks get wet.
nudge: The sound water makes when you jump in.

clue: One banana, two friends. You break it into two halves.
nudge: Break into parts.

clue: Take a knife and smear jam over your toast from edge to edge.
nudge: Cover something with a thin layer.

clue: The race is only 50 meters. You run as fast as you possibly can.
nudge: Run very fast for a short way.

clue: The teacher says, Everybody up! You get off your chair and onto your feet.
nudge: Be up on your feet.

clue: Ready, set, go! The race begins.
nudge: Begin.

clue: Hold the ladder tight so it does not wobble or shake.
nudge: Firm and not wobbly.

clue: Turn the handlebars of your bike to go around the corner.
nudge: Make a car or bike go the way you want.

clue: Lift one foot and put it down in front of the other. Now do it again.
nudge: One move of your foot.

clue: Move the spoon round and round in your hot soup.
nudge: Mix with a spoon.

clue: I am what cars must do at a red traffic light.
nudge: The opposite of go.

clue: Before the race, reach your arms way up high and touch your toes to warm up.
nudge: Make your body long.

clue: The weightlifter picks up a huge heavy bar over her head.
nudge: Having lots of power.

clue: The test is tomorrow. You sit at your desk and read your notes again and again.
nudge: Learn for a test.

clue: The hawk dives down so fast, you can barely see it.
nudge: Very fast.

clue: Arms forward, kick your legs, and move through the pool like a fish.
nudge: Move through water.

clue: You and your best friend chat on the phone for an hour.
nudge: Say words to someone.

clue: The giraffe can eat leaves from the top of the tree.
nudge: The opposite of short.

clue: Your big sister shows you how to tie your shoelaces, step by step, until you can do it.
nudge: Help someone learn.

clue: Grandma gives you a gift. You hug her and tell her how glad you are.
nudge: Say you are grateful.

clue: What is 9 plus 6? Use your brain and work it out.
nudge: Use your mind.

clue: The fielder picks up the ball and sends it flying to the wicket keeper.
nudge: Send a ball flying with your arm.

clue: Mom says, Your room is a mess! Put your toys away and make your bed.
nudge: Neat.

clue: Flip a coin up in the air. Heads or tails?
nudge: A light throw.

clue: Feel the soft kitten fur with your fingertips.
nudge: Feel with your hand.

clue: Put thin paper over the picture and follow the lines with your pencil.
nudge: Copy by following lines.

clue: Pack your bags, get on a plane, and fly to another country.
nudge: Go on a trip.

clue: You close your eyes and fall back, sure that your friend will catch you.
nudge: Believe someone will not let you down.

clue: You have never ridden a bike, but you hop on and give it a go anyway!
nudge: Have a go at something.

clue: At the corner, go left instead of straight.
nudge: Change direction.

clue: To open the bottle, hold the cap and spin it round.
nudge: Turn something round.

clue: All the kids pull together as one team to win the tug of war.
nudge: Come together as one.

clue: A pocket knife can cut, open cans and fix things. It is very handy!
nudge: Helpful.

clue: The little knight faces the huge dragon and does not run away.
nudge: Very brave.

clue: On Sunday, you go to Grandma's house to spend the day with her.
nudge: Go to see someone.

clue: The rainbow colors are so bright and bold, they almost glow.
nudge: Very bright and strong.

clue: The bus is not here yet. You stand at the stop until it comes.
nudge: Stay until something happens.

clue: One foot, then the other, not running, all the way to the shop.
nudge: Move on foot at a normal pace.

clue: You stroll around the park with no plan, just looking at things.
nudge: Go around with no plan.

clue: The cocoa is not hot and not cold. It feels just right.
nudge: A bit hot.

clue: Muddy hands? Use soap and water to get them clean.
nudge: Clean with water.

clue: The spider goes over and under, in and out, to make its web.
nudge: Cross threads to make cloth or a web.

clue: It is a secret, so you speak very softly into your friend's ear.
nudge: Talk very quietly.

clue: The river is so big from one side to the other, you cannot throw a stone across.
nudge: The opposite of narrow.

clue: Your team scores the most goals! You get the cup.
nudge: Come first.

clue: The old owl in the story knows lots and always gives good advice.
nudge: Knowing a lot from life.

clue: You look up at the stars and ask, How far away are they?
nudge: Think and ask why.

clue: Take a pencil and put your name at the top of the page.
nudge: Put words on paper.

clue: A baby, a puppy, a kitten. They have not been alive for long. They are...
nudge: The opposite of old.

clue: You practiced all year and finally won the gold medal. You did it!
nudge: Reach a goal.

clue: You look up to your football hero and want to be just like him.
nudge: Think someone is great.

clue: Your team wins and goes on to the next round of the cup.
nudge: Move forward.

clue: The coach tells you, Try keeping your eyes on the ball.
nudge: Give someone tips on what to do.

clue: Can I go play outside? Mom says yes, you may.
nudge: Let someone do something.

clue: The magician pulls a rabbit out of a hat and everyone gasps. Wow!
nudge: Surprise someone a lot.

clue: The clown juggles and falls over to make the kids giggle.
nudge: Make someone laugh.

clue: The scientist breaks the problem into small parts to see how it all works.
nudge: Study the parts closely.

clue: The principal speaks on the loudspeaker: Tomorrow is a holiday!
nudge: Tell everyone news.

clue: The teacher asks, What is 5 plus 5? You put up your hand and say Ten!
nudge: Reply to a question.

clue: The play ends. Everyone claps their hands loudly.
nudge: Clap for someone.

clue: You show Dad your plan for the treehouse. He nods and says, Yes, good idea.
nudge: Say yes to something.

clue: Put the flowers in the vase so they look pretty.
nudge: Put things in a nice order.

clue: After a long drive, you finally get to the beach!
nudge: Get to a place.

clue: Take all the little parts out of the box and put the toy robot together.
nudge: Put parts together.

clue: You pass the ball to your friend, and she scores the goal!
nudge: Help.

clue: Clip your name badge onto your shirt.
nudge: Fix one thing onto another.

clue: You have never done a cartwheel. But you give it a try!
nudge: Try.

clue: Every day you go to school and are there for every class.
nudge: Be present at something.

clue: Hold the magnet near the pins. They jump to it!
nudge: Pull toward itself.

clue: A big puddle is on the path. You walk around it so you do not get wet.
nudge: Keep away from.

clue: At the end of the year, the best reader gets a shiny prize on stage.
nudge: A prize for doing well.

clue: I am a flat, oval nut with a brown skin. People grind me up to make a milk with no cow in it.
nudge: A flat nut in trail mix. Some milk is made from it.

clue: I am red or green and I crunch when you bite me. Kids bring me to the teacher, and one a day keeps the doctor away.
nudge: A crunchy fruit that grows on trees. Snow White ate a bad one.

clue: I look like a small peach with soft, fuzzy, orange skin. Inside I have one hard stone.
nudge: A small orange fruit, like a tiny peach.

clue: I am green and bumpy outside, soft and green inside, with a giant seed in the middle. You can spread me on toast.
nudge: The green fruit you mash to make guacamole.

clue: I sizzle and pop in the pan on Sunday morning. I am crispy strips that come from a pig.
nudge: Crispy breakfast strips that go with eggs.

clue: I am a chewy bread shaped like a ring. You slice me in half and spread cream cheese on me.
nudge: A round bread with a hole in the middle.

clue: I am long, curved and yellow. Monkeys love me. You peel me, and if you leave my skin on the floor, someone slips!
nudge: A yellow fruit that monkeys love.

clue: I am a grain that grows in the field like wheat. People put me in soup to make it thick.
nudge: A grain like wheat, often in soup.

clue: I am a green leaf that smells sweet. People put me on pizza and blend me into green pasta sauce.
nudge: A green herb on pizza.

clue: Jack traded his cow for magic ones of me. Then I grew a giant stalk up to the clouds!
nudge: A small seed you eat. Jack had magic ones.

clue: I am the meat that comes from a cow. You find me in burgers and in tacos.
nudge: Cow meat. Rhymes with leaf.

clue: I am a round root that grows under the ground. I am dark red and I can turn your fingers pink.
nudge: A dark red root vegetable. It sounds like beat.

clue: I am a soft, flaky little bread at breakfast. In England, I am the name for a cookie.
nudge: A small soft bread. Dogs get a crunchy kind as a treat.

clue: I come in a loaf and you slice me up. Spread butter on me, or put two of me around a filling.
nudge: What you use to make a sandwich.

clue: I look like a tiny green tree. Mom says eat me up before you get dessert!
nudge: A green vegetable shaped like little trees.

clue: I am the clear, hot liquid in soup. Grandma makes me from chicken when you are sick.
nudge: Thin soup water. Rhymes with cloth.

clue: I am yellow and soft. I melt on your hot toast and on your corn.
nudge: A yellow spread made from cream.

clue: I am a big round ball of green leaves. People slice me up to make coleslaw.
nudge: A leafy round vegetable, like a big lettuce.

clue: I am sweet and covered in frosting. At your birthday, I hold the candles while everyone sings.
nudge: A birthday dessert you cut into slices.

clue: I am a sweet treat in a shiny wrapper. On Halloween, you knock on doors to get me.
nudge: Sweets for trick or treat.

clue: I am orange and I grow under the ground. Rabbits love to munch me, and snowmen use me for a nose.
nudge: An orange vegetable that rabbits love.

clue: I am a nut shaped like a little curve or a bean. My name sounds like a sneeze!
nudge: A curved nut. Its name sounds like ah choo.

clue: I am long, green and crunchy. People dip my sticks in peanut butter. I am mostly water.
nudge: Crunchy green sticks for dipping.

clue: I come in a box. You pour me in a bowl, add milk and eat me with a spoon at breakfast.
nudge: Crunchy breakfast food in a bowl with milk.

clue: I am made from milk. Mice love me, and people say my name when you take a photo.
nudge: Say this to smile for a photo.

clue: I am small, round and red, and I grow in pairs on a stem. People put me on top of an ice cream sundae.
nudge: A tiny red fruit with a stem.

clue: I cluck on the farm, and I am also what you eat as nuggets or drumsticks.
nudge: The meat in nuggets.

clue: I am a little red or green pepper that is very hot. One bite can make your mouth burn!
nudge: A spicy pepper. Also a spicy bean stew.

clue: I am thin, crunchy and salty. I come in a bag, and you can hear me crunch at a party.
nudge: A crunchy snack in a bag.

clue: I am a drink made by squeezing lots of apples. People drink me warm in the fall.
nudge: A cloudy apple drink. Rhymes with spider.

clue: I am a brown spice made from tree bark. I make buns and apple pie smell amazing.
nudge: A sweet brown spice on buns.

clue: Lemons, limes and oranges all belong to my family. We are juicy, and some of us are very sour.
nudge: The family of lemons and limes.

clue: I look like a tiny brown nail and I am a strong spice. Also, one piece of garlic is called me.
nudge: A small piece of garlic. Rhymes with stove.

clue: I am a brown powder. Mix me with hot milk on a snowy day and add a marshmallow.
nudge: The powder that makes hot chocolate.

clue: I am a big, hairy brown ball that grows on a palm tree. Crack me open and there is white flesh and juice.
nudge: A hairy brown fruit from palm trees.

clue: Grown ups drink me hot in the morning to wake up. I am dark brown and I smell strong.
nudge: A hot drink that grown ups need in the morning.

clue: I am a sweet round treat, often with chocolate chips. You dip me in milk. A blue monster loves me!
nudge: A sweet treat the Monster eats.

clue: I grow on a tall stalk in yellow rows. Pop me in a pot, and I turn into a movie snack.
nudge: Yellow seeds that grow on a cob.

clue: I am a thin, crispy square. You put cheese on me. Parrots in cartoons always want one.
nudge: A crispy square snack. Polly wants one.

clue: I am the thick, rich part of milk. Whip me fast and I turn fluffy, for the top of your pie.
nudge: Thick part of milk. Rhymes with dream.

clue: I am a tiny bit of bread or cookie left on the plate. Ants carry me home.
nudge: A tiny piece of bread. Rhymes with thumb.

clue: I am long and green and very cool. People slice me for salads and put me on their eyes at the spa.
nudge: A long green vegetable. Pickles were this first.

clue: I am a small sweet treat, just right for one person. I sit in a paper wrapper with frosting on top.
nudge: A tiny birthday treat in a paper wrapper with frosting.

clue: I am a spicy dish with sauce, often yellow or orange. You eat me with rice or flat bread.
nudge: A spicy dish from India. Rhymes with hurry.

clue: I am a sweet, yellow sauce made with milk and eggs. Pour me warm over your pudding.
nudge: Sweet yellow sauce for dessert. Rhymes with mustard.

clue: Milk, cheese, butter and yogurt all come from this one group. It is also a farm full of cows.
nudge: Milk, cheese and butter all belong in this group.

clue: I am a sweet, sticky brown fruit from a palm tree. My name is also a day on the calendar.
nudge: A sticky brown fruit. Also a day on a calendar.

clue: I am the big meal at the end of the day. Mom calls you to the table to eat me.
nudge: The evening meal.

clue: I am soft and squishy. You squish me, shape me and put me in the oven to make bread or pizza.
nudge: Raw bread before baking. It sounds like doe.

clue: I am a small pocket of dough with meat or veggies inside. People steam me or fry me.
nudge: A little stuffed pocket of dough.

clue: A hen laid me this morning. You can scramble me, fry me or boil me, but break me first!
nudge: Breakfast food in a shell.

clue: I am a soft, purple fruit with lots of tiny seeds inside. People make cookie bars out of me.
nudge: A purple fruit. Rhymes with pig.

clue: The fish man takes out every bone and hands you a soft, flat piece with none left. What did you buy?
nudge: A boneless piece of fish. The T at the end is silent.

clue: Ice cream comes in lots of me: chocolate, vanilla, strawberry. Which one do you pick?
nudge: The taste of a food.

clue: I am a white powder made from wheat. You mix me with eggs and water to make bread and cakes.
nudge: White baking powder. Sounds like flower.

clue: Apples, bananas and grapes are all me. I am sweet and grow on trees and vines.
nudge: The group name for apples and bananas.

clue: I am a very sweet, soft, chocolate treat cut in squares. I melt in your mouth.
nudge: A rich chocolate sweet. Rhymes with judge.

clue: I am a white bulb split into little pieces. I smell very strong, and in stories vampires hate me.
nudge: A smelly bulb that keeps vampires away.

clue: I am a root that tastes hot and spicy. There is a cookie man made with me who runs away!
nudge: A spicy root. A cookie man is made with it.

clue: I grow in bunches on a vine. I am small, round, green or purple. Dry me out and I become a raisin.
nudge: A small round fruit in bunches. Rhymes with tape.

clue: I am a thick brown sauce made from meat juice. Pour me over mashed potatoes on Thanksgiving.
nudge: A brown sauce for mashed potatoes.

clue: Mom says eat your leafy vegetables. She is talking about me, like spinach and kale.
nudge: Leafy vegetables. The color of grass.

clue: I am a tropical fruit, green outside and pink inside, with lots of little seeds.
nudge: A tropical fruit. Rhymes with lava.

clue: I am small and round in a hard shell. People mix me with chocolate to make a sweet spread for toast.
nudge: The crunchy bit in chocolate spread.

clue: Basil, mint and parsley are all me. I am a little green plant that makes food smell nice.
nudge: A plant used in cooking. Rhymes with curb.

clue: Bees make me in their hive. I am sweet, golden and sticky. Pooh Bear loves me!
nudge: Sticky golden food made by bees.

clue: I am the sweet, colorful layer on top of a cake. You spread me with a knife or squeeze me from a bag.
nudge: Frosting on a cake.

clue: I am thick and sweet, made of squashed fruit and sugar. Spread me on toast with a knife.
nudge: Fruit spread for toast. Also a traffic one.

clue: I am a sweet, clear fruit spread. Peanut butter and me make a perfect sandwich.
nudge: Goes with peanut butter.

clue: Squeeze an orange and I come out. You drink me from a box with a straw.
nudge: A drink made from fruit.

clue: I am a dark green leaf with curly edges. Healthy people put me in salads and smoothies.
nudge: A leafy green. Rhymes with tale.

clue: I am red and made from tomatoes. You squeeze me on your burger and dip your fries in me.
nudge: Red sauce for fries.

clue: I look like a giant green onion. My name sounds like a drip from a pipe.
nudge: A long onion. Sounds like a drip.

clue: I am yellow and very sour. One taste makes your face scrunch up!
nudge: A sour yellow fruit.

clue: I am a tiny, flat, round seed, orange or green. People cook me in soup.
nudge: A small round seed for soup.

clue: I am the green, leafy part of a salad. I also go crunchy inside your burger.
nudge: The main leaf in a salad.

clue: Before the bread gets sliced, it is one whole long lump. What is it called?
nudge: A whole bread before you slice it. Four letters.

clue: I am the meal you eat in the middle of the day. At school, I might be in a box.
nudge: The midday meal.

clue: I am sweet, juicy and orange inside, with a big flat seed. People call me the king of fruits.
nudge: A sweet tropical fruit. Rhymes with tango.

clue: I am big and round, with a thick skin. Cut me open and I am juicy and sweet. Kids spit my seeds in summer.
nudge: A big juicy fruit. A green striped one is red inside.

clue: I am white and cows give me. Drink me to grow strong bones, or pour me on your cereal.
nudge: A white drink from cows.

clue: I am a green leaf that tastes fresh and cool. I am in your toothpaste and in some gum.
nudge: A cool fresh flavor in gum.

clue: I am a sweet bread that looks like a giant cupcake. I often have blueberries inside.
nudge: A breakfast cake, often blueberry.

clue: I look like a tiny umbrella. I grow in damp, dark places, and you put me on pizza.
nudge: A tiny umbrella you can eat.

clue: I am a yellow sauce in a bottle. Squeeze me on your hot dog!
nudge: Yellow sauce for hot dogs.

clue: I am long and soft. You slurp me up from a bowl of soup or ramen.
nudge: A long soft strip you slurp.

clue: Squirrels hide me in the ground. I have a hard shell that you need to crack.
nudge: Squirrels eat this. Rhymes with hut.

clue: I am a brown seed that is ground into a spice. People sprinkle me on eggnog.
nudge: A brown spice for eggnog.

clue: I am a warm, mushy breakfast in a bowl. Add brown sugar and raisins on a cold morning.
nudge: A hot, mushy breakfast in a bowl.

clue: I am a grain that horses love. Cook me with milk for a warm breakfast, or bake me into cookies.
nudge: A grain for hot breakfast that horses love. Four letters.

clue: I am a yellow liquid. Mom pours me in the pan before frying, and I sizzle when it is hot.
nudge: Cooking liquid for frying.

clue: I am small, green or black, and salty. I grow on trees. My pit is a hard stone inside.
nudge: A small salty fruit on pizza.

clue: Crack some eggs, whisk them, pour them in a pan. Add cheese, fold it over, and eat me!
nudge: Folded eggs with fillings.

clue: I have many layers of skin. When you cut me, I make you cry, even if you are not sad!
nudge: A layered vegetable that makes you cry.

clue: I am round and juicy. You peel me and pull me into slices. My name is also my color.
nudge: A fruit and a color.

clue: I am round and flat, cooked in a hot frying dish. You flip me, stack me and pour syrup on top.
nudge: A flat breakfast stack with syrup.

clue: I am an orange tropical fruit. Inside I am soft and full of little black seeds.
nudge: A tropical fruit with black seeds.

clue: I am a little green leaf put on the side of a plate to make it look pretty.
nudge: A green herb used to decorate.

clue: I come as spaghetti, macaroni or bow ties. Boil me in water and add red sauce.
nudge: Italian food like spaghetti.

clue: I am a sweet, flaky baked treat, from the bakery. Croissants and tarts are me.
nudge: A flaky bakery treat.

clue: I am soft, fuzzy and orange pink. I am juicy and sweet. James had a giant one in a book!
nudge: A fuzzy fruit. Rhymes with beach.

clue: I am in a shell. Elephants love me, and you can turn me into a butter for sandwiches.
nudge: It makes a butter that goes with jelly.

clue: I am a green or yellow fruit. My top is thin and my bottom is fat, like a light bulb.
nudge: A fruit shaped like a light bulb. Sounds like pair.

clue: I am a tiny, round green ball that rolls off your plate. I grow in a pod with my brothers.
nudge: A tiny green ball in a pod.

clue: I am a nut with a brown shell. Grandma bakes me into a sweet pie in the fall.
nudge: A nut in a famous pie.

clue: I am the black spice that sits next to salt on the table. I make you sneeze!
nudge: The friend of salt.

clue: I was a cucumber, but I sat in salty, sour water for a long time. Now I am green and crunchy.
nudge: A sour cucumber.

clue: I am round with a crust. Inside I am filled with apples or cherries. You eat me in slices.
nudge: A dessert with a crust. Apple is a kind.

clue: I am a small, round purple fruit with a pit inside. Dry me and I become a prune.
nudge: A purple fruit. Rhymes with drum.

clue: Heat my little yellow seeds and they burst! You eat me in a big bucket at the movies.
nudge: A movie snack that bursts open when hot.

clue: I grow under the ground. You can mash me, bake me or fry me into French fries.
nudge: French fries are made from this.

clue: I am twisted into a funny knot shape, salty and brown. You buy me at the mall or a ball game.
nudge: A salty knot shaped snack.

clue: I am a plum that was dried out. I am wrinkly and brown, and grandparents say I am good for you.
nudge: A dried plum.

clue: I am soft and creamy and you eat me with a spoon. I come in chocolate and vanilla cups.
nudge: A soft creamy dessert.

clue: I am big, round and orange. In October, people carve faces in me and put a candle inside.
nudge: A big orange thing kids carve at Halloween.

clue: I am a small red root that grows in the garden. I am crunchy and a little spicy.
nudge: A small red root vegetable.

clue: I was a grape, but I dried in the sun. Now I am small and wrinkly, and I go in your cereal.
nudge: A dried grape.

clue: I tell you exactly what to put in and how to cook it, step by step. You find me in a cookbook.
nudge: Cooking instructions.

clue: I am a chopped up pickle sauce. You spoon me on a hot dog with mustard.
nudge: A green topping for hot dogs.

clue: I am tiny white grains. You boil me in a pot, and people in Asia eat me with every meal.
nudge: Small white grains for curry.

clue: I am a big bowl of lettuce, tomatoes and cucumbers. Mix me with dressing!
nudge: A bowl of fresh veggies.

clue: I am a chunky red dip made of tomatoes, onions and peppers. Dip your tortilla chips in me!
nudge: A tomato dip for chips. Also a dance.

clue: I am tiny white grains. I make chips and fries taste good. The sea tastes like me.
nudge: What makes the sea taste bad to drink.

clue: Put cheese and ham between two slices of bread, and I am ready for your lunch box.
nudge: Two slices of bread with something in the middle.

clue: I am a liquid that goes on top of food. Pasta gets a red one of me and nuggets get a dip.
nudge: Ketchup is one kind.

clue: I am a tiny white seed on top of a burger bun. My name is in a famous street on kids' TV.
nudge: Tiny seeds. Open this, says Ali Baba.

clue: Put bananas, berries and milk in a blender. Whizz it up and drink me through a straw.
nudge: A thick fruit drink from a blender.

clue: I am a little bite to eat between meals, like a granola bar after school.
nudge: A little food between meals.

clue: I am hot and you slurp me from a bowl with a spoon. Chicken noodle is a kind of me.
nudge: Hot food in a bowl you eat with a spoon.
